text: nail's -a bounds the whole cloud search, not the retries after the first attempt. -a 1 is one attempt with no recovery; -a 0 asks for no attempt at all and panics at an unreachable! in cloud_stage.rs. nail's help text still says 'attempts to recover', which is what misled us into an -a 0 arm that cost an overnight cloud-search run. On the toy, recovery earns 0.03 sensitivity at -B 8 and 0.00 at -B 16.
